notes: Covers the municipal budget only. School-district and county taxes on the same property-tax bill belong to separate governments and are not included.

Political money counts PAC, business and union contributions to candidates for Berkeley Heights Township municipal office and mayor reported to NJ ELEC since 2022-10-01. Individual donors ($4,650 in the same period), candidates' own committees and party committees are not counted. Small campaigns may file without itemizing, so some contributions may not appear.
Contractor pay-to-play disclosures and transparency practices have not been loaded yet; transparency is not scored.

Red flags: surveillance programs come from the EFF Atlas of Surveillance, a public database of news reports and public records, searched on 2026-10-01. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program takes 2.5 points off the score (up to 10) instead of being counted as spending. Finding nothing earns no credit.

Red flags: 4 license-plate cameras are mapped inside Berkeley Heights Township's borders in OpenStreetMap (0 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. Flock cameras count as a red flag whoever runs them. Other brands count only when the town is the recorded operator, since many have no operator recorded.
